Topological and Health Diagnosis for Street Networks

Source: R/diagnose.R
walk_diagnose_network.Rd

Evaluates the topological connectivity, dangling nodes, potential undershoots, and component fragmentation of a user-supplied street network before building the routing graph. This function does not alter geometries, leaving repair decisions to the user.

Usage

walk_diagnose_network(data, snap_search_radius_m = 10, crs = NULL)

Arguments

data

An sf object containing LINESTRING or MULTILINESTRING street segments.

snap_search_radius_m

Maximum distance in meters to search for potential undershoots (unconnected ends located near another segment). Default is 10.0 meters.

crs

Optional target metric CRS (e.g. EPSG code or proj4string). If provided, data is transformed to this CRS before distance calculations.

Value

A walk_diagnosis S3 object containing:

summary

Tibble with diagnostic statistics.

components

Table of detected connected components and their total lengths.

undershoots

sf point collection of suspicious dangling endpoints.

isolated_edges

sf line collection of edges not belonging to the giant component.

data

Original spatial line data.

search_radius_m

The search radius parameter used.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
diag <- walk_diagnose_network(mis_calles, snap_search_radius_m = 5)
print(diag)
plot(diag)
} # }
